text: {"features":[{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"The degree to which the letter is free of spelling, grammar, and presentation errors that affect professionalism.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent spelling, grammar, or formatting errors are immediately noticeable and materially distract from the application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Numerous visible mechanical errors appear throughout the letter, but the overall meaning remains recoverable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"A few noticeable mechanical errors appear, yet the letter is still easy enough to read."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The prose is mostly clean and professional, with only minor slips that do not distract."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is polished and essentially error-free, sustaining a highly professional presentation."}]},{"name":"Organizational clarity","description":"How clearly the letter is structured so a reviewer can quickly follow the candidate's fit for the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The case for fit is hard to follow because information is scattered, abrupt, or poorly sequenced."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a basic structure, but transitions are choppy and the argument feels loosely assembled."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter follows an understandable sequence, and the main qualifications can be extracted without much effort."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a clear logical progression from motivation to evidence to fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is exceptionally easy to scan, with each paragraph advancing a coherent and well-ordered case for the role."}]},{"name":"Specificity of evidence","description":"How well the letter supports its claims with concrete examples, responsibilities, and outcomes rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on generic claims and provides little concrete detail about work performed or results achieved."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter names some relevant activities or tools, but examples are thin, vague, or unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter provides several relevant examples, though the context or impact remains somewhat broad."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Most major claims are backed by concrete examples, recent wins, or tangible responsibilities."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter consistently anchors its claims in precise, observable accomplishments and outcomes that make the fit highly credible."}]},{"name":"Role motivation","description":"How convincingly the letter explains why this specific kind of security engineering work is appealing to the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The interest expressed is generic and could apply to many software engineering roles."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows some interest in security or backend work, but gives limited personal rationale."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states a clear role-relevant motivation, though it remains fairly broad."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter links motivation to prior experience, values, or a deliberate career direction in security engineering."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a compelling and credible reason for wanting exactly this kind of security automation work."}]},{"name":"Google tailoring","description":"How specifically the letter is tailored to Google and this Information Security Engineering context rather than to any large employer.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter could be sent unchanged to almost any employer."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Google or scale only in a generic aspirational way."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows some tailoring to large-scale platform work or to Google's general reputation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly connects the applicant's background to Google's internal scale, foundational systems, or security culture."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is sharply tailored to Google's Information Security Engineering mandate and explains why the applicant fits that specific environment."}]},{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"How well the letter shows understanding of the role as a systems problem focused on scaling security work through automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows little understanding of the job as a leverage problem for security teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions automation or security operations only in broad terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter recognizes that tooling can reduce manual security work, but offers limited role-specific detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly frames the role as scaling scarce security expertise through automation such as triage, analysis, or response systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates nuanced understanding of leverage points such as expert-attention bottlenecks, variant analysis, or auditable autonomous workflows."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"The extent to which the letter emphasizes helping developer teams adopt secure practices through usable tools and defaults.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter focuses only on personal technical tasks and shows no sign of helping other engineers work securely."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter lightly references serving others, but does not explain how security should fit developer workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows general interest in making security useful to product teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explicitly emphasizes reducing friction, setting defaults, or building tools developers will actually adopt."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes secure-by-default developer enablement a central theme and shows strong empathy for how busy engineers work."}]},{"name":"Formal education level","description":"The strength of the applicant's formal academic preparation relative to the role's stated degree preferences.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant bachelor's degree and no higher degree."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant bachelor's degree plus some additional formal technical or security study signal, but no graduate degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant master's degree in a technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant doctoral degree in a technical field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents a relevant doctoral degree and explicitly makes advanced study part of a strong case for the role's depth or complexity."}]},{"name":"Production software track record","description":"The strength of the applicant's experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter describes only a modest production record, such as just a few years of experience or only a small number of launched services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid early-career production experience with some maintenance and launch responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates clear experience testing, maintaining, and launching multiple production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial multi-year ownership of several production services, suggesting strong engineering maturity."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents an extensive record of owning, maintaining, and launching many production services over a long period."}]},{"name":"Maintainer mindset","description":"How strongly the letter conveys reliability, maintainability, and long-term ownership as part of the applicant's engineering approach.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no real signal about reliability, maintainability, or long-term ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter briefly mentions keeping systems running or doing operational work, but without a deeper philosophy."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values maintaining inherited systems or building software others can live with over time."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter emphasizes maintainability practices such as testing, typing, careful releases, or designing with future owners in mind."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes dependable, maintainable engineering a defining theme and ties it directly to the higher bar required for security tooling."}]},{"name":"Go backend depth","description":"The strength of the applicant's role-relevant experience designing and implementing backend systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter names Go as a skill but gives little evidence beyond using it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a regular language, with limited detail about backend design or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid experience building or maintaining production services in Go."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a primary language for backend design and implementation across multiple production systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates deep, central Go backend expertise with clear design or operational ownership of production systems over time."}]},{"name":"Python engineering depth","description":"The strength of the applicant's experience using Python for production services, tooling, and automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not describe any Python experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python lightly, with little sense of scope or rigor."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows practical Python use for tooling, automation, analysis, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Python as a significant production language across services and internal tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong production-grade Python engineering, emphasizing maintainability, testing, typing, or extensibility."}]},{"name":"AI systems experience","description":"The strength of the applicant's hands-on experience building and operating AI or LLM-based functionality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not describe any AI or model-related work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI only vaguely, without clear hands-on use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows direct hands-on work with AI or LLM features in production or near-production settings."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes meaningful production AI work plus some attention to evaluation, correctness, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong applied AI experience with credible emphasis on trustworthy deployment, evaluation, and operational safeguards."}]},{"name":"Agentic tooling design","description":"The strength of the applicant's experience designing agent-based or autonomous systems relevant to the role's AI-agent responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not describe any agentic systems or autonomous tooling experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agents or autonomous workflows only loosely, with little architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows direct work on agentic tooling or bounded multi-step automated workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter explains how agents are structured in production, especially how Python agents interact with Go services or controls."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates end-to-end ownership of agentic architecture with clear attention to boundaries, permissions, auditability, or controlled autonomy."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"The strength of the applicant's direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not describe any direct vulnerability-handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security automation broadly, but not concrete triage, classification, or routing work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes some automation around vulnerability reports or issue handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly shows ownership of tooling that classifies, deduplicates, routes, or otherwise reduces manual vulnerability triage."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents vulnerability-handling automation as a major accomplishment with specific workflow improvement or saved expert effort."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"The strength of the applicant's experience performing security assessments such as threat modeling, code review, or attack-surface analysis.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not describe any security assessment experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security review briefly, with little detail about methods."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows hands-on assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or attack-surface analysis."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes structured assessment practice with follow-through, such as validating fixes or assessing both new and legacy systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong assessment depth through a rigorous approach and clear translation of findings into remediation."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic strength","description":"The strength of the applicant's evidence of practical skill with algorithms and data-structure-driven problem solving.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not describe any algorithmic strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter claims strength in algorithms or data structures without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives at least one relevant example of using algorithms or data structures to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong practical fluency through concrete redesigns of important system paths or processing logic."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates standout algorithmic maturity with a compelling example of making a previously hard problem tractable or dramatically faster."}]},{"name":"External security development","description":"The strength of evidence that the applicant actively builds security skill outside ordinary product work through certifications or competitive practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions no outside-the-day-job security skill-building."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions light or occasional security practice with limited signal of depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows meaningful extra investment in security through a foundational certification or regular capture-the-flag participation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates strong external security development through serious competitive practice, an advanced certification, or both."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter provides exceptional outside-the-job security signal, such as OSCP or consistently high capture-the-flag performance, framed as ongoing skill sharpening."}]},{"name":"Self-directed technical initiative","description":"The strength of evidence that the applicant independently builds substantial technical work outside assigned job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention any side projects, open-source work, or self-initiated technical contributions."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small personal project or occasional upstream fix with limited substance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows consistent self-directed building or open-source contribution outside core job duties."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a substantial side project, active open-source maintainership, or repeated meaningful upstream contributions."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates outstanding initiative through ambitious independent systems work, notable open-source ownership, or both."}]}]}
